summary.zh-CN: 一个从零手写的两层神经网络(2 → tanh 隐藏层 → sigmoid),用真实反向传播在浏览器里实时训练一个线性不可分的二分类任务,决策边界随训练肉眼可见地弯曲。纯本地 JS 数学,不联网、不加载任何机器学习库。
summary.en-US: A 2-layer neural net (2 → tanh hidden → sigmoid) written from scratch, trained live in the browser with real backprop on a non-linearly-separable task — watch the decision boundary bend as it learns. Plain local JS math, no network, no ML library.
